"Sex (I'm a ...)" is a song by American new wave band Berlin from their second studio album, Pleasure Victim (1982).
The song was co-written by group members John Crawford, Terri Nunn, and David Diamond and sung as a duet by Crawford and Nunn.
It has an electronic disco arrangement, inspired by Giorgio Moroder, and in particular Donna Summer's "I Feel Love".
